jobs.description:
**Why join us?

**Muuto is rooted in the Scandinavian design tradition characterized by enduring aesthetics, functionality, craftsmanship and an honest expression. By expanding this heritage with forward-looking materials, techniques and bold creative thinking, our ambition is to deliver new perspectives on Scandinavian design.

We are looking for a PR Intern to support Muuto’s global PR and brand activities and provide practical support to Channel Marketing. You will gain hands-on experience in branding, communication, press relations, and marketing support within an international design company. The internship starts as soon as possible, ideally for a period of six months or longer.

Working closely with the Global PR Manager and colleagues across the organization, you will help build awareness of Muuto and bring our designs and stories to the press and audiences across international markets. You will also assist the Channel Marketing team with defined tasks, helping keep presentations, marketing materials, and digital platforms up to date.

**The ideal candidate

**You are curious, structured, and proactive, with an interest in PR, communication, design, and interiors. You are eager to learn how PR works within a large international design company, from shaping stories and building brand awareness to supporting press relations and events.

You enjoy organizing and collaborating, and are happy to help with practical tasks. You bring attention to detail, a service-minded approach, and a willingness to learn while supporting several activities at the same time.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**As our PR Intern, you will support the Global PR Manager with daily coordination and execution and support the Channel Marketing team. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Support PR communication, including drafting and distributing press releases.

• Assist with press loans, influencer gifting, and contact updates.

• Support monthly PR tracking and KPI reporting.

• Help coordinate PR events, fairs, press meetings, and influencer activities.

• Keep PR materials and tools organized and up to date, and assist with ad hoc PR projects.

• Help update sales presentations and marketing materials using existing templates.

• Maintain marketing content and assets across digital platforms and support smaller Channel Marketing projects.

**Your profile

**

• An interest in PR, communication, and brand marketing, supported by relevant studies or practical experience.

• A structured and detail-oriented approach, with good organizational skills and an ability to follow up on tasks.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

• A proactive, service-minded attitude and confidence communicating with internal and external contacts.

• A collaborative mindset and willingness to help with practical coordination and event support.

• Confidence working with presentations, documents, and spreadsheets.

• Curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the ability to work independently on clearly defined tasks.

• An interest in design, interiors, lifestyle media, and influencer relations.

**What We Offer

**

• An internship based at Muuto’s Copenhagen headquarters, starting as soon as possible and ideally lasting six months or longer.

• The opportunity to take ownership of a project relevant to Muuto, with coaching and regular feedback from senior colleagues.

• Hands-on experience with global PR, press communication, influencer activities, and events in an international design company.

• Close collaboration with the Global PR Manager and the opportunity to learn through day-to-day PR work.

• Insight into Channel Marketing and collaboration across teams, with room to contribute ideas and take responsibility for defined tasks.

• A collaborative work environment characterized by entrepreneurial spirit, openness, and shared responsibility.

**Who We Hire?

**At Muuto, our mission is to deliver new perspectives on Scandinavian design. We are an international team of ambitious and passionate people - all driven by the desire to expand on the Scandinavian design tradition with a forward-looking, creative and honest approach. We are looking for qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities who share this same mindset. Individuals who wish to actively contribute and bring their opinion to the table. Individuals who would like to bring a wealth of new perspectives to our company.

That is why we are always keen to hear from talented people who wish to join our company - regardless of gender identity, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief and disability status. We are committed to equal opportunity employment.

To learn more about Muuto, our products and designers, please visit www.muuto.com

MillerKnoll complies with applicable disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MillerKnoll Talent Acquisition at careers_help@millerknoll.com.

Do you enjoy turning workplace needs into real solutions and taking projects from idea to implementation? As our new Workspace Specialist, you will combine project leadership with hands-on workspace development in an international environment.

You will lead workplace projects from early concept through implementation, helping transform our global offices into inspiring, functional and future-ready environments.

**

What you will be doing**

As a key part of our Global People & Workspace team, you will help shape workplace environments across Grundfos. You will translate business and employee needs into practical workspace solutions while ensuring alignment with our global Workspace Standards.

Your main responsibilities include:

• 
Lead workplace projects from concept through implementation.

• 
Coordinate stakeholders, suppliers, and consultants throughout the project lifecycle.

• 
Manage project timelines, budgets, risks, and deliverables.

• 
Ensure alignment with Grundfos Workspace Standards.

• 
Support workplace change management and user adoption activities.

• 
Advise local Facility Management teams globally on implementing Grundfos Workspace Standards.

• 
Balance your time 50/50 between managing larger projects with external architects and independently creating workplace layouts for smaller projects.

• 
Create professional presentations and project materials using Adobe InDesign.

What makes you a great fit

You are structured, proactive and a strong team player who takes ownership, with a practical understanding of workplace needs and the ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.

• You have project management experience, preferably within Activity Based Working, workplace, corporate real estate or office fit-out.

• You have experience working with AutoCAD and Revit.

• You have strong stakeholder management skills and are confident working across different countries and organisational levels.

• You collaborate effectively with suppliers, contractors and external consultants.

• You are comfortable working independently and taking projects from idea to implementation.

• You communicate fluently in English and are willing to travel when required.

Why you'll love working here

Day to day, you can look forward to:

• A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.

• Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.

• On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

Join Grundfos, apply today!

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Are you ambitious, curious, and eager to get hands-on experience close to senior leadership? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, and where you are trusted with real responsibility from the start?

About the position

We are looking for a talented and driven Student Worker to support the SVP of Government and the Head of Bid Excellence in their daily work.

This is not a traditional student position focused mainly on administrative tasks. You will work closely with senior leaders, gain insight into commercial and strategic priorities, and take ownership of your own assignments and projects.

You will be involved in a broad range of activities across the organisation and quickly build an understanding of how decisions are made and turned into action.

What you will do

• Drive your own projects and initiatives, from initial idea and analysis to coordination and follow-up.

• Help drive strategic and commercial priorities across Government and Bid Excellence.

• Prepare management material and presentations for meetings, decision-making and stakeholder communication.

• Conduct analyses and research and turn information into clear recommendations and actionable insights.

• Coordinate activities across the organisation, working with colleagues and stakeholders from different functions and business areas.

• Support leadership meetings and follow-up, helping ensure that decisions, actions and priorities move forward.

• Improve the way we work, including identifying opportunities to use AI, automation and better processes.

What you will gain

• A Unique exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making.

• A steep learning curve with responsibility from day one.

• The opportunity to build a strong network across KMD.

• Hands-on experience with strategy, bids and commercial priorities.

• The chance to turn academic knowledge into real business impact.

Who you are

You are currently pursuing a relevant university degree within Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Strategy, Political Science, Public Administration or a similar field, and are enrolled in either the latter part of your bachelor's degree or a master's programme.

• You are proactive and comfortable taking ownership.

• You are structured and able to manage multiple priorities.

• You have strong analytical and communication skills.

• You enjoy collaborating with stakeholders across different functions.

• You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• You are able to work approximately 15 hours per week alongside your studies.

Interested?

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible by sending us your CV and application.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Want to know more about the role? Feel free to contact hiring manager: Nicolai Holme Milsø Nygård - NHL@kmd.dk

About the Job

We are looking for a Senior Security Architect to shape and strengthen security across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services. You will join a small, senior architecture team at the center of Stibo DX's transformation from self-hosted and hybrid deployments to a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform.

This is a hands-on, embedded role. You will work with engineering, product, platform, operations, customer-facing teams, and legal to ensure security is built into our solutions by design, not added afterwards. You will turn security strategy and risk into practical architecture, reusable patterns, and controls that teams can implement.

Your goal is to establish a consistent security architecture across Stibo DX and give teams clear standards, patterns, and guardrails to make secure architecture decisions. Early priorities will include establishing a security architecture baseline, identifying key security gaps across our SaaS platform, strengthening security architecture reviews and threat modelling, and defining reusable security patterns for engineering teams.

The role is primarily focused on security architecture, product and platform security, and secure engineering practices. You will also drive the technical aspects of security governance and support compliance activities when needed, including security certifications, customer security requirements, regulatory obligations, risk assessments, policies, and audit preparation.

You will work alongside peer architects covering Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration, reporting to the Director of Solution Architecture. Our governance model is based on minimum necessary control: decisions close to teams, with oversight proportional to risk and impact.

Security remains a shared responsibility. The Senior Security Architect owns the security architecture direction, standards, patterns, and cross-cutting guidance, while Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration architects continue to consider and address security within their respective domains. Engineering teams remain responsible for implementing and operating the required controls.

What You'll Do

• Define security architecture strategy across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services, including principles, standards, target architectures, guardrails, and roadmaps.

• Embed secure-by-design practices into product discovery, solution design, delivery, and operation, working with teams early rather than reviewing security only at the end.

• Lead security architecture reviews and threat modelling for product, platform, customer, and technology initiatives; identify risks and align on practical mitigation with accountable teams.

• Shape identity and access management covering authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access, service identities, secrets, and Zero Trust principles.

• Strengthen cloud and platform security for AWS, Kubernetes, networks, workloads, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data, and shared SaaS platform capabilities.

• Define reusable security patterns and controls for APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, encryption, key management, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, and secure configuration.

• Embed security in the software development lifecycle by defining practices and guardrails and helping teams integrate security into engineering practices, automation, architecture decision records, and delivery pipelines.

• Lead security governance and compliance work when needed including security policies, control design, risk assessments, evidence coordination, audit preparation, and remediation planning.

• Translate external requirements into technical action including customer security expectations, contractual commitments, privacy requirements, and relevant frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and CRA.

• Raise security maturity across Stibo DX through coaching, practical guidance, cross-team collaboration, and clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 10+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud/platform engineering, or cybersecurity, with 4+ years in a senior security architecture or technical security leadership role.

• Proven experience designing and securing cloud-native, distributed, and microservices-based systems in production.

• Practical experience with SaaS and multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, identity, data protection, and shared platform controls.

• Experience leading threat modelling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and remediation planning across multiple teams or product areas.

• Experience defining security standards, patterns, reference architectures, and governance that teams can apply in practice.

• Experience working with security and compliance frameworks and translating them into proportionate technical and organizational controls.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineers, architects, product leaders, operations, customers, legal, and senior stakeholders.

Technical expertise

• Cloud security, preferably AWS, and Kubernetes/container security.

• Identity and Access Management, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, federation, privileged access, and service identities.

• Application, API, integration, and event-driven security.

• Network security, workload protection, secrets management, encryption, certificates, and key management.

• Secure software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD security, and software supply-chain security.

• Security logging, monitoring, detection capabilities, vulnerability management, and incident preparedness.

• Threat modelling, security risk analysis, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles.

Nice to have

• Experience leading or materially supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR security controls, CRA, or similar initiatives.

• Experience with enterprise customer security assessments, contractual security requirements, and audit evidence coordination.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience helping an organization establish or mature a security architecture and governance capability.

Personal qualities

• Hands-on and credible with engineers, while able to communicate security clearly with product, customers, legal, and leadership.

• Pragmatic and risk-based: able to balance security, usability, operational complexity, cost, and delivery speed without compromising critical controls.

• Collaborative and influential, using expertise, evidence, and trust rather than creating unnecessary gates.

• Structured and decisive, able to make risks, responsibilities, and architectural decisions explicit.

• Curious, adaptable, and motivated by building long-term security maturity while helping teams deliver now.

What We Offer

• Real influence on the security foundations of Stibo DX's cloud-native SaaS transformation.

• Ownership of security architecture and a central role in shaping security governance and compliance maturity.

• Hands-on work on real product, platform, customer, and operational challenges, not security from an ivory tower.

• A small, senior architecture team with trust, autonomy, and meaningful responsibility.

• High visibility across product, engineering, operations, customer-facing teams, legal, and leadership.

• The opportunity to create reusable security practices and patterns with lasting impact across Stibo DX.

Interested?

Apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

For any questions, please reach out to hiring manager Safdar Aqeel Safdar on safs@stibodx.com.

Help us empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Our platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world's most ambitious and successful media organizations.

We are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Our roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports our continued growth.

Among our customers are The New York Times, Hearst, Gannett, The Economist, A-Media, JP/Politikens Hus, Mediahuis, The Hindu, and many others.

If you want to be part of a team where individuals are valued and trust is a driver, we encourage you to apply today!

jobs.occupation: Project & People Manager, Defence Services, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
_Ready to lead software deployment, training and technical support projects for Defence customers, develop your team and shape a growing department? Combine hands-on project delivery with direct people management, bringing mission-critical software to military customers across the Nordics.

**The job

**As Project & People Manager in our Nordic Constellation, you will manage and lead multiple customer projects simultaneously. These projects involve deploying our SitaWare and Iris product suites into customers’ organisations, delivering training services, providing technical support for military exercises and helping customers get the most from our products.

Alongside responsibility for the delivery and implementation of our Defence product suites at our customers, you will:

• Ensure delivery to the agreed scope, schedule and quality standards while maintaining and developing long-term customer relationships.

• Work closely with our business development team to expand customer engagement in new and established markets by shaping and scoping solutions, preparing estimates and writing commercial proposals.

• Take direct people and line management responsibility, including recruitment, employee development and retention.

• Together with your team, foster an engaging workplace where people enjoy coming to work.

You will on a regular basis travel to customer locations in the Nordic countries, most predominantly in the Capitol Region in Denmark.

**Joining the team

**Join Defence Services, Nordic, and help customers in Denmark and across Scandinavia bring our SitaWare solutions into their organisations. In Copenhagen, you will join a Defence Services team of around 10 people, including fellow managers, solution architects, solution engineers and student workers. As our department grows, you will have the opportunity to help shape how we work and strengthen our leadership team. Reporting to the Senior Director for the Nordic Constellation, you will collaborate with fellow managers and colleagues across constellations, combining hands-on project delivery with people management.

**What You Will Bring

**You bring solid experience leading software or IT projects using agile methods and enjoy combining project delivery with managing and developing employees. You take ownership and are ready to grow your responsibilities as you deliver results.

We are also looking for:

• A relevant degree in IT, software or a related field, preferably at master’s level.

• Direct line management experience with formal responsibility for employees, including coaching, motivation and development, along with the ability to influence people both within and outside the organisation.

• Experience working directly with customers and other stakeholders - experience in defence or a similar industry is a clear advantage.

• Fluency in spoken and written English.

• Project management certification, such as PMI, PRINCE2 or IPMA Level B/C, and Scrum or ITIL certification backed by practical experience - these are an advantage, but not a requirement.

• A decisive, results-driven mindset combined with an analytical, structured approach, and the ability to engage customers, end-users, senior management and your team to deliver projects within budget, on schedule and to the required quality standards.

• A collaborative colleague who contributes to both achieving results and fostering a positive team culture.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

**Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

**When you join us in Copenhagen, you’re not just getting a desk at one of the city’s best locations - you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

**Never stop developing

**Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1300 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

**Start your development here

**We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today.

Curious about this position?

jobs.occupation: German-speaking Sales & Customer Success Manager - DACH Market
jobs.description:
Do you want to take our DACH markets to the next level, grow with a fast-moving startup, and join our amazing international team? If building relationships with customers and providing top-level service sounds exciting, you are the one we are looking for! 🚀

Limepack is a fast-growing scale-up in the printed packaging industry. We are on a mission to help small businesses become brands. Our vision is to become the go-to European platform for custom branded food packaging, and we are currently available across 14 countries. 🌍

Join our international team based in Denmark and around the world. Our office is in Frederiksberg, where English is the main language. We enjoy each other’s company both at the office and at occasional events after hours. 💚

As a Limepack Sales & Customer Success Manager, you will play a key role in developing the German, Austrian and Swiss markets, maintaining relationships with existing customers, and converting new inbound leads, while working closely with 9 international sales colleagues responsible for different countries.

Our open and friendly work environment will allow you to gain insights into how our business is run, to take part in decision-making, and to have a lot of influence on growing the DACH markets but also on our overall sales strategy. 📈

📋Your responsibilities at Limepack:

• Drive growth in your market: Take ownership of growing sales by identifying commercial opportunities, prioritizing high-value prospects and proactively moving opportunities forward.

• Turn leads into customers: Convert inbound enquiries into orders through proactive calls, consistent follow-up and clear recommendations. Understand what customers need, communicate our value and close the sale.

• Build repeat business: Turn first orders into lasting customer relationships. Stay close to your customers, anticipate their next purchase and actively pursue opportunities to cross-sell, upsell and grow their business with Limepack.

• Develop high-value accounts: Become a trusted takeaway packaging expert for our A Customers. Combine excellent service with a commercial mindset to increase order value, purchase frequency and long-term customer value.

• Collaborate to deliver results: Work closely with product, finance, operations and logistics to deliver a seamless customer experience that supports conversion, retention and growth.

Requirements

🎓Your qualifications:

• You speak and write German at a native level and communicate confidently in English.

• You have previous sales experience in German, Austrian and Swiss markets, or a Customer Success background with responsibility for revenue growth and conversion.

• You are motivated by measurable results: winning new customers, growing revenue and seeing your actions directly impact sales performance. Targets give you energy and focus. You enjoy spotting opportunities and bringing pace and initiative to move conversations towards a sale.

• Experience with outbound sales and proactive outreach, such as prospecting, cold calling or reactivating inactive accounts, is a plus.

• You are confident in picking up the phone and handling objections. You combine persistence with sound judgment and a clear understanding of the customer’s needs.

• You build strong customer relationships and actively look for ways to turn first orders into repeat business and grow each account.

• You enjoy working towards shared goals in an international team, contributing ideas and sharing what works.

• You work in a structured way, use CRM systems to manage opportunities and follow-ups, and quickly adapt to new digital tools.

• You learn quickly, welcome direct feedback and confidently ask questions or challenge ideas to improve results.

Benefits

💚 We offer:

A young and international team where your input is valued and can be quickly implemented. You will work with competent, motivated, and engaged colleagues who are not afraid of testing new ideas. We prioritize culture and look for people who want to be part of a friendly and proactive team – and who enjoy joining our events and shared moments outside the office. 🥳

The position is 37 hours per week with salary based on qualifications and previous experience. We have a union agreement with HK. The place of work is our Frederiksberg office with one set day per week where we work from home.

📝 Application:

We review applications continuously, so don’t wait too long to apply! We would ideally like to have our new colleague starting in December.

In case you have any questions or need more information regarding the job position, please contact Elsa (Head of People & Culture) on +45 89 88 86 54. Please apply using the application form. We do not accept CVs or applications by email.

If you don’t meet every single requirement but feel excited about the role, we encourage you to apply anyway. ☺️

Limepack is a profitable fast-growing start-up in the custom-printed food packaging. We are on a mission to help small businesses become brands by making custom takeaway packaging available for the many. Our vision is to become the go-to European platform for custom branded food packaging, and we are currently available across 14 countries. 🌍

We are a Copenhagen-based company with a strong remote team. Join our international team of 29 employees where we believe in work life balance, a predictable work week and that time off is completely off.

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will join a team of engineers to build features that contribute directly to the Databricks platform. We're hiring across all of our teams, including full stack, backend, infrastructure, systems, tools, cloud, databases, and customer-facing products. You will have a dedicated mentor and will join our 2027 intern cohort where you'll connect with engineers, other interns, and leaders from across the company.

We are hiring Software Engineering Interns across multiple offices. Please apply for the single location that you're the most interested in, and we will discuss more with you as you move through the process. We can only consider one application in 30 days.

**The Impact You Will Have

**

• Work with a team to build features for the Databricks platform

• Manage your project end-to-end, including design, code, and feedback

• Learn about building a platform that scales quickly while maintaining quality and security

**What We Look For

**

• You will graduate between fall 2027 and summer 2028 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject

• You have implementation skills with a general purpose program language, such as Python, Java, or C++

• You have good knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and OOP principles

• You are excited to solve ambiguous problems with a collaborative team

**About Databricks

**Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

**Benefits

**At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

**At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

With a focus on the international defense industry, Sky-Watch A/S develops, manufactures, and implements high-tech solutions in the form of drone and sensor technology. Through cutting-edge UAS technology, battle-proven products, experienced instructors, skilled technicians, and dedicated support personnel, the company delivers the best M-UAS platform and associated UAV solutions. These solutions empower decision-makers in complex and high-risk environments worldwide to make safe and effective decisions—ultimately enhancing the overall success of their missions.

Sky-Watch is dedicated to establishing relationships and ensuring visibility among key decision-makers in its target customer segments. This audience primarily consists of stakeholders at political, ministerial, general staff, and operational levels.

Founded in 2009, Sky-Watch is headquartered in Støvring and currently employs +145 people. The company culture is driven by passionate and highly skilled employees motivated by the ambition to develop technology of the highest quality, as well as a curiosity that ensures continuous product innovation and value creation.

To strengthen the Product Marketing Team, Sky-Watch is now looking for a highly skilled and driven

Product Marketing Manager

1st class product – Go-to-Market – Sales Enablement

Do you want to play a key role in shaping how a fast-growing international defence company positions, communicates and brings its products to market? As the new Product Marketing Manager at Sky-Watch you will take ownership of product and portfolio messaging, use cases, and go-to-market execution across the entire platform, ensuring clarity, credibility, and impact throughout a high-consideration B2G/defence buying process. You will join a high-tech company with market-leading UAV technology, operating in a rapidly growing and strategically important defence sector, where innovation, proactivity, and technical excellence are deeply embedded in the culture.

You will report directly to the Director of Product Marketing, and your key responsibilities will include:

• Positioning & Messaging: Own product and portfolio positioning, value propositions, and messaging frameworks across channels.

• Use Cases & Stories: Own use cases and case stories, ensuring they are reused across marketing, sales, and partner activities.

• Go-to-Market & Launches: Lead product launches, major updates, and software releases, including narratives, release communication, and enablement materials.

• Sales & Partner Enablement: Develop and maintain sales and partner enablement assets, supporting effective pitching and objection handling.

• Market & Competitive Insight: Translate customer, market, and competitor insights into clear messaging and go-to-market priorities.

• Trust & Compliance Content: Ensure procurement-facing and compliance-related content supports the buying journey clearly and consistently.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Align Product, Marketing, Sales, and partners by translating roadmap decisions into market-ready communication.

To succeed in this role, you hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing/Communication, Technology Management, or a related field combining commercial and technical focus. You bring at least five years of experience in B2B or B2G product or solution marketing, preferably from technology-driven, regulated, or complex industries such as defence, aerospace, or B2B SaaS. You have proven experience defining positioning and value propositions, developing go-to-market plans, and creating practical sales enablement materials in close collaboration with product management, engineering or software teams, as well as sales and channel partners. You are skilled at translating complex technical products into clear customer value and compelling narratives and are fluent in professional English.

You reside within an hour drive from the office in Støving, and you must be willing to travel approximately 30-40 days a year.

As a person, you take ownership of your responsibilities and bring energy and commitment to your work. Furthermore, you are proactive and structured, and you are able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You thrive in a fast-changing environment and manage to keep calm and handle multiple products, projects and deadlines in parallel. With a strong analytical and curious mind-set, you can synthesize complex information into clear, actionable plans and translate complex topics into compelling, easy-to-understand communication. Finally, you are highly collaborative and relationship-oriented, able to build trust and alignment across multiple stakeholders, while also working independently when needed.

Are you the new Product Marketing Manager at Sky-Watch in Støvring? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or religion. For further information about the position, please contact consultant from Sensu A/S, Martin Tveit, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

For more information about Sky-Watch, please visit www.sky-watch.com

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and no application deadline is set.

jobs.occupation: EPC Procurement Lead, Advanced Bioenergy Fund
jobs.description:
_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure?  If so, CIP Terra Technologies Advanced Bioenergy Fund is currently looking for a_n EPC Procurement Lead to join our team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Team

The EPC Procurement Lead will become part of a small and experienced team of professionals contributing to the delivery of large-scale international biogas projects. Our goal is to assemble a motivated, diverse, and skilled team that works to make a meaningful, positive difference for the planet. This position will directly report to the Head of EPC Procurement and will be based in Copenhagen, with frequent travel required in Europe.

Role

As our EPC Procurement Lead, you act as the Project Legal Counsel and provide end‑to‑end legal support for large scale biogas projects, with an emphasis on project development, construction, transactions, and contract management. The role requires direct practical experience leading complex EPC contracts, negotiations, and claims management within an international project setting.

Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

• Develop and implement CAPEX procurement strategies aligned with project development schedules and portfolio priorities.

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and administering complex project documentation, including EPC contracts, supply agreements, service agreements, and related side agreements.

• Act as procurement lead for assigned projects, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, managing internal approval stage gate process

• Oversee commercial negotiations with EPC contractors and key suppliers, including pricing, delivery timelines, warranties, and performance guarantees

• Coordinate with Engineering, insurance and ESG teams on risk allocation, LDs, technical guarantees, and contract interfaces

• Managing contract negotiations with a pragmatic, risk‑based and commercially oriented approach.

• Advising internal stakeholders on contractual structures, risk allocation, and mitigation strategies.

• Ongoing contract management, interpretation, and enforcement throughout the project lifecycle.

• Legal support for M&A transactions, joint ventures, acquisitions, disposals, and portfolio transactions in the biogas sector.

You

The ideal candidate is a fully qualified lawyer with 10+ years of post-qualification experience, gained in‑house or in private practice, with a strong business acumen. You have demonstrated the ability to manage complex sourcing and negotiations, and bring solid commercial judgment with experience in risk allocation and contract structuring.

Moreover, you have demonstrated experience in large, complex renewable energy or infrastructure projects, preferably in an international context.

We look for the following in the candidate:

• Extensive experience with FIDIC contracts, EPC contracts, supply agreements, service agreements, and NDAs.

• Commercial judgment and risk-based decision-making

• Experienced in negotiating complex commercial and project contracts.

• Experience in claims handling and contract management.

• Ability to work effectively in a changing, partially defined environment

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Terra Technologies’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Terra Technologies is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Terra Technologies to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, and ethnicity.

About CIP Terra Technologies

CIP Terra Technologies is a project delivery company working for CIP. CIP Terra Technologies is majority owned by the funds managed by CIP, with the purpose of delivering best-in-class project development and execution services to the growing portfolio of land-based renewable energy assets.

We engage in the energy transition through specialist project delivery, value creation, and collaboration with trusted third-party suppliers. Our core focus is the development, procurement, construction, and delivery of renewable energy projects, and we provide a variety of services including technical development, engineering, supply chain, construction management, and project execution.

We provide global support and a local presence in our key markets, and our teams are continuously delivering and refining services tailored to a wide range of technologies – from onshore wind, solar PV and battery energy storage systems, to bioenergy, thermal and transmission infrastructure. For more information, please visit CIP Terra Technologies.

Optimized CIP Platform

Earlier this year, we introduced an optimized CIP Platform. With three platform companies providing services to CIP—and while maintaining our current relationship with Copenhagen Offshore Partners (COP), CIP’s exclusive offshore wind development partner—we have effectively strengthened our organizational and operational capabilities, creating a platform scaled for growth and designing the CIP blueprint for the future.

We have established CIP Molecule Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company dedicated to molecule projects; CIP Terra Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company managing a diverse portfolio of onshore projects; and CIP Fund Solutions, a delivery company with expertise in complex fund management and investment services. For more info on this, please see: Optimized CIP Platform.

Senior Business Controller

Introduction

Are you driven by strategic business development, and do you have the gravitas to challenge the executive board? Do you want the crucial mandate to translate complex data into business-critical action? Then you are the Senior Business Controller we are looking for in Business Controlling!

We are looking for a commercially astute and proactive Senior Business Partner who sets the direction and serves as a trusted advisor to executive management by translating complex data into clear strategic and operational recommendations that drive our growth.

Your Impact

As a Senior Business Controller, you will have a direct influence on the company's bottom line and strategic direction. You will identify business potential, challenge existing processes, and advise key stakeholders. You will become the vital link ensuring that our strategy is executed and delivers results across operational departments.

Meet Your #Teamlidl

In Business Controlling, we are passionate about creating transparency and challenging the status quo in a dynamic, high-performance environment. You will join a dedicated team of specialists where we value in-depth professional sparring, integrity, and strong team spirit. We are currently transforming the controlling function, actively integrating modern AI agents and self-service solutions to shift our focus from daily operations to strategic advisory.

About the job

We offer a central and highly visible role with a short path from analysis to execution, providing ample opportunity to bring your professional authority into play. You will report directly to the Teamlead in Business Controlling and collaborate closely with the Head of Controlling, the CFO, and the Board of Directors.

Your primary tasks will be:

• Strategic Annual Planning: Driving the content and facilitation of the annual planning process, where you critically challenge, validate, and analyze targets and underlying initiatives.

• Executive Reporting & Analyses: Delivering business-critical and ad-hoc assessments for core functions (including revenue analysis) and preparing sharp, action-oriented management commentaries focusing on deviations and trends.

• Business Optimization: Developing well-founded, strategic recommendations for executive management to optimize operations, alongside evaluating and quality-assuring complex business cases.

• Trusted Advisory: Acting as a proactive sparring partner for the business and crafting compelling decision templates and executive presentations.

• Predictive Forecasting: Performing plausibility checks on planning reports and enriching machine-generated forecast values with your business insight.

• Performance Steering: Leading profitability analysis projects and setting the agenda for management performance meetings.

• Digital Transformation: Driving the development of next-generation controlling tools and empowering the business to autonomously utilize self-service BI and AI agents.

About you

About You

We are looking for a trustworthy profile with significant analytical capacity, strong commercial intuition, and natural executive presence. You thrive at the intersection of deep-dive data analysis and persuasive executive-level communication, possessing the diplomatic tact required to drive change across the organization.

We also expect you to have:

• Solid Professional Foundation: A relevant master’s degree combined with senior-level experience in cross-functional business partnering and strategic business analysis.

• Advanced Data Understanding: Broad experience in evaluating complex data structures, quality-assuring advanced forecasts, and proficiency in modern BI environments.

• Business Enablement: A proven track record of evaluating complex business cases and the ability to methodically elevate data-driven decision-making across operational departments.

• Executive Communication: Outstanding communication skills and full professional proficiency in Danish, English, and German (a strict requirement). You effortlessly translate complex data into clear, strategic messages for top management.

We offer

• A data-driven and challenging position with broad cross-functional exposure across controlling.

• A dynamic, dedicated, and informal work environment within an international retail group.

• Limitless career opportunities and professional challenges.

• Option for a health insurance package.

• Discount schemes across a wide range of providers within travel, shopping, culture, fitness, and more.

**

Headquarters in the heart of Aarhus**

We have a large, innovative headquarters located at Godsbanen in Aarhus. As an employee, you will have access to:

• Free fitness center.

• In-house massage service.

• A healthy canteen offering breakfast, lunch, and convenient take-away dinner options – all with a minimum of 30% organic ingredients.

• The opportunity to join social activities such as rooftop morning yoga, running club, family days, and Friday bars.

The recruitment process

Feel free to simply send your CV along with a few lines about your motivation for the job! We know how much time and energy job hunting takes, so make it easy on yourself and skip the traditional cover letter.

As we review applications on an ongoing basis, we reserve the right to close the job posting early—saving you from spending time applying if we have already initiated the interview process or found the right candidate.

During the recruitment process, you can expect: screening, a phone interview, a job interview, and potentially a case study.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please contact our recruiter, Johanne Rasmussen, at +45 60 34 02 38 on weekdays between 09:00 and 14:00, or by sending an email to jobilidlhq@lidl.dk.

Sales Manager (f/m/x)

TÜV SÜD Group – A global leader in the field of testing, inspection, management system certification and product certification renowned for quality, integrity and technical excellence.

Established more than 150 years ago in Germany, TÜV SÜD Group is a leading global provider of technical services with more than 30 000 highly skilled employees across 1 000 offices worldwide. TÜV SÜD Group offers a wide range of testing & product certification, inspection, auditing & system certification, training and knowledge services. We are a premium quality, safety, and sustainability solutions provider.

Shape the Future of Product Compliance and Market Access

TÜV SÜD is a trusted global partner for testing, inspection, certification, and regulatory compliance. To strengthen our Product Service business, we are looking for an ambitious and customer-focused Sales Manager to drive growth in Scandinavia. In this role, you will develop strategic customer relationships, identify new business opportunities and help local manufacturers bring safe, compliant and high-quality products to global markets supported by experts and laboratories in Germany.

Your Tasks

• Drive business growth by acquiring new customers and developing existing accounts within the Consumer Product portfolio

• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers at local manufacturers and brand owners

• Identify market trends, customer needs, and emerging business opportunities

• Develop commercial strategies and tailored service solutions together with our technical specialists in our German headquarter and laboratories

• Prepare, present, and negotiate proposals, contracts, and annual business reviews

• Manage sales opportunities and customer interactions through our CRM system

• Collaborate closely with international technical, operational, and commercial teams

• Represent TÜV SÜD at industry events, trade fairs, customer meetings, and professional associations

• Contribute to the continuous development of our market presence and business strategies in the region

Your Qualifications

• Broad Experience and Knowledge within Testing, Inspection & Certification (TIC) is mandatory, Experience within Consumer Products, Manufacturing, Retail, Consumer Goods or related industries is desirable

• Proven track record in B2B sales, Business Development, Key Account Management or Technical Sales

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Business, Engineering, Technology or a related field

• Strong commercial mindset combined with excellent customer relationship skills

• Confident communicator with outstanding presentation and negotiation abilities

• Ability to translate complex technical and regulatory requirements into customer value

• Self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and results-oriented personality

• Experience working with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications

• Fluent in Danish and English or German, both written and spoken

• Willingness to travel within the region and occasionally internationally

Do you want to help ensure quality in energy infrastructure projects? Can you turn quality requirements into practical activities and support projects through to handover? And do you have experience with quality management, audits and inspections? Then join COWI as our new Quality Consultant.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

We are looking for a Quality Consultant to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects on assignments of both shorter and longer duration. You will help ensure that projects follow the customer’s governance framework and can be handed over to the operations organisation at the required quality level, with all supporting documentation. Your work may span electricity transmission projects, including cables, overhead lines and substations; gas distribution and transmission networks, including natural gas and biogas facilities and stations; oil pipelines; and gas storage facilities.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support projects in applying internal processes and tools and provide guidance and support on quality-related matters.

• Consistently promote and embed quality management in projects so that documentation, products and deliverables meet the specified requirements

• Plan, carry out and document the necessary quality activities in collaboration with the project team, including internal and external audits and inspections of project partners.

• Ensure that quality-related experience and lessons learned are shared within the customer’s organisation.

• Prepare project quality plans.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You work in a structured and systematic way and take a proactive approach to building relationships. You collaborate and communicate on an equal footing with internal and external stakeholders involved in construction projects. You bring professional credibility in your field and can work independently.

On top of that, you will have:

• An understanding of the structure and application of quality management systems.

• Experience with project- and process-related work.

• Experience with quality management activities in infrastructure and construction projects, including quality assurance (QA) and providing input to quality control (QC) activities.

• Experience carrying out quality activities, including audits and inspections of internal and external parties involved in projects.

• Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.

• The ability to communicate in Danish and English, both orally and in writing, at negotiation level.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Start date: February/March 2027

Duration: 6 months

**About The Job

**As an Oncology Medical Affairs Student Worker, you will support Sanofi's North Europe Oncology Medical team in mapping the oncology landscape, particularly in solid tumours, and contributing to real-world evidence (RWE) activities. You will gain hands-on experience in Medical Affairs, working with scientific information, treatment guidelines and research projects that support efforts to improve the lives of patients with cancer.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Research and organise information on national and international oncology treatment guidelines, relevant organisations and key healthcare stakeholders.

• Support oncology landscape mapping, particularly in solid tumours, including identifying relevant guidelines and potential gaps.

• Monitor updates to treatment guidelines, scientific publications and medical congresses, preparing clear summaries for the team.

• Support real-world evidence activities, including literature searches, mapping data sources and registries, study documentation and project tracking.

• Assist with real-world evidence governance activities and the preparation of study overviews and presentations.

• Support the Medical Affairs team with research, analysis, insight gathering and preparation of internal materials.

• Create and maintain structured databases, stakeholder maps and project trackers in line with compliance requirements.

**About You

**To excel in this role you will need to have:

• Currently enrolled in a Master's degree programme in Medicine, Pharmacy, Biomedicine, Public Health, Health Sciences, or a related field.

• Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both English and Danish.

• An interest in oncology, Medical Affairs and real-world evidence.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to organise, interpret and summarise complex scientific information.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience using scientific literature databases such as PubMed is an advantage.

• A structured, curious and proactive approach to work, with the ability to collaborate effectively with others.

**About Sanofi

**We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

**Why choose us?

**

• Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.

• Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.

• Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.

• Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives.

• Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being.

• Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date should we receive a sufficient number of applications.

All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. If you want to work in an AI-first environment, help redefine how work is done in an industry, and be part of a team that's changing an entire industry, we'd love to have you on board.

**🤩 About The Role

**We are looking for Senior Account Executive for the DACH market who loves the chase, the close and the craft. You’ll own a territory and build your own pipeline of high-value targets, with SDR support, and booming inbound channel feeding you qualified opportunities. You call the shots on where to hunt, who to warm, and how to win. We’ll back you with marketing air cover, product firepower, and leadership you can trust for support and development. For someone ambitious, this is a genuine opportunity to be a founding AE for the DACH market and support building All Gravy in Berlin.

**🎯 What You Will Do

**

• Create and run your target list of dream logos in our ICP. Name them, map them, multi-thread them.

• Work a blended pipe: your self-sourced opportunities plus BDR-sourced meetings you turn into revenue.

• Full cycle everything: discovery → tailored demo → value proof → commercial design → close → high-five.

• Build business cases that make budget holders nod and sign (ROI, payback, the whole nine yards).

• Feedback like a pro: turn deal learnings into sharper messaging, better product bets, and smoother process.

**🙌 You’ll thrive here if you…

**

• You speak excellent German and English, and are based in Copenhagen.

• 5+ years of SaaS sales under your belt, fluent in consultative selling, and MEDPICC. Psst... If you’ve sold into hospitality, we’re listening even harder.

• You’re curious, ambitious, disciplined, and self-driven.

• Are owner-minded. You don’t wait for leads, you create momentum and you love a clean CRM.

• Can navigate complex cycles and senior stakeholders, you’re credible in the boardroom and fun.

• Are data-curious and coachable. You test, learn, and iterate faster than most people.

**💎 Why All Gravy

**

• Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

• Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

Ready to roll? Curious, competitive, kind? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. Attitude and growth mindset matter. Let’s build the future of frontline work together.

**AI Academy Intake - Copenhagen (on-site, full-time)

**At Light, we're redefining how software is built, how it's delivered, and how it works.

We're building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it's used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy run on Light. We're building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

The AI Academy

The AI Academy is where Light builds its future leaders for an ever-changing world. It's a small cohort of exceptional early-career people who take an operating process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, product or any other team, and rebuild it so AI agents do the work and humans handle the exceptions. Then they move on to the next one.

We believe roles will increasingly merge, and that cross-functional collaboration and broad knowledge of the business will define high-performing teams. The Academy is built around that:

• Training. You start with a period of training on how to use AI to drive business outcomes: tools, agents, automations, and how to judge their output.

• Several functions at once. You then apply it across several functions, splitting your time between teams such as marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success and product.

• Focus. Over time you move into fewer functions, where you've had the most impact and want to go deepest.

In this role you're a member of Light's AI Academy. You'll undergo specialised AI training and be pushed to use AI in every aspect of your job and to re-think the status quo from first principles.

This training will enable you to effectively build operations and companies at scale. If you aspire to be a future single-person unicorn founder, this is the ideal training ground.

**Who This Is For

**You must meet this requirement: an exceptional level of achievement in a highly competitive endeavour. Work experience in itself is irrelevant, past hires have been 17 years and older. For example:

• A gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI)

• Experience at McKinsey QuantumBlack, the Goldman Sachs Special Situations Group or TMT group (regular IBD do not apply), Optiver, Jane Street or similar.

• Having built or sold a company

• Competed in elite-level sport (e.g. a sub-8-hour Ironman, the Olympic Games, or a European or World Championship, football or basketball at highest level)

• A FIDE chess rating of 2,400 or higher (IM level)

• An equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour

• Top of class in high-school year

If you're applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you don't have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar at Light is high, and this is more than just a job. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

We hold two bars: outperforming your metrics, and being kind and supportive of each other. Exceptional ability without kindness is not a fit.

What you'll work on

You'll be in charge of building agentic factories that re-think what is possible across product, marketing, implementation, customer service.

• Rethink work from first principles. Take a process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, or product. Ask what outcome it exists to deliver, and redesign it around what AI now makes possible. Making the old process faster is the easy part.

• Own operations end to end. Take full ownership of processes across finance operations, people operations, and legal and compliance, working directly with the Chief of Staff to CEO. Run them, then rebuild them so agents do the work and nothing falls through the cracks.

• Build the agents and workflows yourself. Identify where manual work can be automated or standardised, and build the solution rather than waiting for someone else to do so.

• Move fast. Ship a first version in hours and iterate several times a day.

• Participate in the AI Academy. Complete the specialised AI training, apply what you learn in every function you work in, and share what worked and what didn't so the rest of the cohort and the teams can adopt it.

• Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the team can rely on what you've shipped.

You'll work alongside exceptional colleagues.

What else we're looking for

• Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn't work.

• Kindness. You make the people around you better.

How we'll measure success

Your work should produce measurable improvements: 10 to 1,000x output capacity.

What you'll get

• Full-time compensation above the standard market rate.

• Every tool available. We give everyone in the Academy access to all the AI tools on the market, and put you in the environment that will make you a success.

• A role based in our Copenhagen office, working alongside the teams and the AI Academy cohort.

• Ownership from your first day, with a path to owning a function.

How to apply

Send your CV.

Include a link to, or a description of, something you've built. Tell us what it does, which parts you built yourself, where it failed, and how you fixed it. Then explain why you want to join the AI Academy at Light.

We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you're ready to take on next.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

BI & Financial Controller

Introduction

Are you driven by financial controlling, and are you passionate about digitalizing manual processes? Do you want to build the bridge between manual operations and the data-driven decision-making foundation of the future? Then you are the BI & Financial Controller  we are looking for!

We are seeking a commercially and technically strong BI & Financial Controller whose primary mission is to shape the backbone of our modern corporate steering. You will bridge deep financial expertise with modern data technologies to eliminate heavy manual routines and build an automated, reliable platform for executive leadership.

Your Impact

As our BI & Financial Controller, you will take ownership of our current manual reporting routines with a clear mandate: to automate and digitalize them. While we operate extensively within concepts and guidelines provided by our international headquarters, you will play a crucial local role. Your impact is felt directly as you push the department toward more data-driven solutions, acting as the vital link between the business, data, and executive management to ensure proactive steering.

Meet Your Team

In Controlling & Analytics, we are facing an exciting transformation journey. We are not fully digitalized yet, but we anticipate and are preparing for this imminent change. You will join a dedicated team where we work determinedly to strengthen our own capacity to develop data-driven solutions. We value professional excellence highly, and we are passionate about actively transforming our field from reactive reporting into proactive product design.

About the job

About the Job

We offer a hybrid and developmental role (Headquarters / Hybrid) where you must thrive at the intersection of daily manual operations and forward-looking automation. You will be responsible for elevating our reporting standards and empowering the organization for a new digital reality.

Your primary tasks will be:

• Operational Reporting: Managing and executing the end-to-end production of daily, weekly, and monthly management reporting packages using standard corporate templates and distribution workflows.

• Automation & Data Ownership: Identifying automation potential across current finance processes and developing digital controlling solutions (KPI frameworks and interactive dashboards).

• KPI Architecture & Financial Steering: Translating strategic corporate goals into measurable, consistent end-to-end driver trees and data-driven performance steering models.

• AI & New Technology: Testing and deploying modern AI tools (e.g., Generative AI) for ad-hoc analysis and predictive forecasting, supported by the international framework.

• Organizational Enablement: Empowering controlling colleagues and operational business units to adopt self-service analytics through hands-on training sessions and best-practice concepts.

• Executive Presentations: Translating BI dashboard outputs and KPI trends into clean, executive-ready presentations and ad-hoc analyses for internal leadership.

About you

About You

We are looking for a profile who enjoys having their hands in the engine room. You do not mind handling and taking ownership of the current manual reporting tasks, but your true motivation lies in eliminating them through smart solutions. You are analytically sharp, possess a creative mindset, and have a genuine enthusiasm for technological innovation.

We also expect you to have:

• Solid Professional Foundation: A university degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable qualification, combined with solid professional experience at the intersection of Finance, Data Analytics, and Controlling.

• Financial Expertise: A sound understanding of core corporate steering concepts (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, value-driver trees) and the ability to translate complex financial dynamics into actionable KPI frameworks.

• Technology & BI Stack: Proficiency with modern BI platforms (e.g., Strategy) and coding (e.g., SQL, BigQuery)

• Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in English is required to ensure seamless collaboration across our cross-functional and international teams. German skills are an advantage, though not a requirement

We offer

• A data-driven and challenging position with broad cross-functional exposure across controlling.

• A dynamic, dedicated, and informal work environment within an international retail group.

• Limitless career opportunities and professional challenges.

• Option for a health insurance package.

• Discount schemes across a wide range of providers within travel, shopping, culture, fitness, and more.

**

Headquarters in the heart of Aarhus**

We have a large, innovative headquarters located at Godsbanen in Aarhus. As an employee, you will have access to:

• Free fitness center.

• In-house massage service.

• A healthy canteen offering breakfast, lunch, and convenient take-away dinner options – all with a minimum of 30% organic ingredients.

• The opportunity to join social activities such as rooftop morning yoga, running club, family days, and Friday bars.

The recruitment process
